verdict.rationale: incident.io documents follow-ups as a first-class feature that captures post-incident work and "track[s] it to completion". Its integrations directory says follow-ups can be exported as GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, or Asana tickets, with changes synced back. Missing for 10: detail on sync behavior such as two-way status or field mapping, evidence for other trackers like Jira or Linear, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker

citations.quote: Capture the work an incident leaves behind, and track it to completion.
Export follow-ups as GitHub Issues and we'll sync any changes.
Export follow-ups as GitLab Issues and we'll sync any changes.
Export and automatically sync your incident actions with tickets in Asana.
